show.description: Toofan is a passionate romantic drama about desire, power, and unexpected love. Atharv Khurana, a billionaire CEO cursed with an inability to feel intimacy, is pushed by family pressure to find an heir or lose everything. But when a simple nurse, Aaradhya, awakens emotions in him that no one else could, their worlds collide—leading to obsession, betrayal, and a storm of love that could change both their destinies.
